Eastern Time · demonstration

Select an available offer. Proposed slots avoid sample meeting conflicts and a daily focus-time block (12:00–2:00 PM). Requests require confirmation; they are not real calendar bookings.

Availability policy

PROPOSED
Protected focus

Every weekday, 12:00–2:00 PM. Scheduling buffer: 15 minutes between meetings.

Open-door windows

Tuesday and Thursday: 11:00–12:00 and 3:00–4:30. Wednesday: 10:00–11:30. Exceptions route through a request.

Response discipline

Acknowledge in one business day; review exceptions at the next daily pulse. Meeting invitations become calendar events only after confirmation.
